text:
maya: Woke up to the dashboard—ARR ticked over our quarterly target. 25% growth! 🎉🥂
devin: YESSSSS!! Great work team. mini parade when? :party-parrot:
nina: can we get macarons? and a tiny gong?
emily: I'll order snacks for the SF office. macarons + sparkling water. any dietary restrictions?
raj: vegetarian + nut-free pls. also virtual confetti for remote peeps? :confetti_ball:
ops-bot: deploy-gong has been scheduled at 15:00 PT. Reaction: :bell:
devin: bringing the sparkler hat collection 😎
maya: can someone record a 30s clip for socials? quick thank-you to early customers
emily: I'll take it. simple script:
```
- 15s: shoutout to customers
- 10s: quick team montage
- 5s: confetti + logo
```
maya: perfect. @raj can you prod design for 5-sec logo animation?
raj: on it. ETA 2 hours.
lunch-bot: Reminder: cafe pops up at 12:00 with free samples today!
nina: love that. can remote folks get an e-gift card instead?
emily: will add Venmo/GC for remote folks. pls DM me names
devin: tiny poll — do we prefer gong sound A (classic) or B (paper-hat)? react with :one: or :two:
maya: :one:
raj: :two:
nina: :two:
emily: :one:
ops-bot: Poll closed. Result: 2 votes for :one:, 2 votes for :two:. Tie — leadership flip coin at 14:50.
maya: thanks y'all. proud of everyone. quick cheers at 15:00 PT in #general. :heart:
